conclusion: In distribution the learned model is marginally faster and catches a few more real outbreak-days, at a cost of about three points of precision on a detector that already over-alarms. The authored threshold rules ship; the model is kept only as this benchmark.
cross_regime_conclusion: The model's small recall and latency edge survives the shift in transmission probability: it is not purely memorised. The edge is still small and still bought with lower precision, and it is still a model of this simulator.
